collection.description: A chief issues a confusing order about shared supplies; villagers begin ignoring it rather than asking questions.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: A {@chief} issues a confusing order about shared supplies; villagers begin ignoring it rather than asking questions.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: The {@chief} clarifies a real shortage and revises the order.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: The {@chief} realizes their instructions contradicted each other.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: (villager), a quiet worker, identifies an overlooked hardship.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: A heated complaint becomes a useful proposal after tempers settle.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: The council agrees to publish clear, reviewable rules.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: The {@chief} accepts that respect cannot be demanded by title alone.

d1.name: Outcome D1
d1.text: A repeat offender faces a proportionate work-related consequence.

d2.name: Outcome D2
d2.text: (villager), who objected respectfully, is not punished for dissent.
